lines.line: ... there were only beings of nature.
Spirits, nymphs, and early mankind living in perfect harmony.
For a thousand years they grew, sharing knowledge and wisdom.
Eventually, these beings became indistinguishable from one another, and thus adopted a new name..
An extension of nature and technology, the Tah'Lo were masters of the weave.
Bestowing magic into artifacts and each other alike, the Tah'Lo enjoyed an age of prosperity.
For some, it was not enough.
The lure of power was all it took to topple the mighty civilization.
Millenia have since passed, and tales of the Tah'Lo have turned into legend.
But once again the power of the Tah'Lo threaten the stablity of the realm.
On a small farm in the countryside, an unlikely adventure begins.
